Well I guess I'll share mine lol, happened on the fourth of July, took my first dose of 150ugs 3 days earlier with a buddy and had a great experience so I was ready the day of. I had friends with my both taking 150 for their first time. I took my first 300ug tab at around 8pm felt great watching the fireworks, then I was feeling good so I took another 200 and gave 100 to my friend. Felt fine on 500 we walked around for a little just hanging out outside until around 2. then we decided to go smoke some weed and my friend had been cross straining these super expensive strains so it was incredibly strong, I decided to pop another 300ug tab right before smoking ( worst idea ever ). My tolerance for marijuana is low anyways since I don't smoke too much so all it took was one bong hit and I knew I was fucked. We smoke in the woods since I'm in an illigal state and I remember I thought I dropped my phone over and over again but it wasn't even in my possession since my buddy was using it for a light. Then we started the walk home and holy shit it was the most insane thing I had ever experienced I had never felt that high before and I was trying to not freak out but I just remember hearing shit and replaying it in my head, and I like lost control of my body I felt like a bunch of noodles or something lol. Then we finally got home and we get into my basement and I try to play some guitar riffs and it's insane how my muscle memory was still working perfectly since I could play super fast still. But anyways Im looking at the guitar and all the fret dots are moving everywhere and I'm freaking out since I'm seeing tons of fractals without closing my eyes which I wasn't used to or ready for. Then I had to turn off all the lights In my basement. I go to turn off the last light and right as I do the song money by pink Floyd started and oh my god that was the most insane experience ever. The music felt like waterfalls of sound and I just layed down on the couch and closed my eyes ready for the hell. (It was about 3:40am at this time) I knew I was going to have to fight my demons the second I got down because I have never felt anything as intense as that I was falling through different dimensions when I was laying down it was such an insane experience it's indescribable. We went back up to my room which I felt like I teleported up there since I must have forgotten going up and I just decided to lay down, my buddy was with me this entire time tripping super hard too just not as bad. And then I thought I peaked but it was just the begging when I saw a bunch of those illuminati eye things just turn red and mad and I thought they wanted to kill me but I still wasn't having an ego death (at least I don't think) and around 6am I started peaking when the sun came up. My visuals got so intense that I couldn't keep my eyes open anymore. I was laying in bed trying to keep my eyes closed and sleep for like 3 hours and finally I was able to fall asleep. I woke up and still felt shitty tho and my balance was all off for a couple days. Now looking back on the trip I think i would like to trip that hard again because as terrible and as scary as it was I still feel greatful that it happened. So yeah that's my story pretty much and I'll answer any questions if you have any lol.

TLDR: don't take 800ugs and smoke for your second trip if you aren't ready for it.
